stop_rule: Two consecutive complete four-ensemble diagnostic passes after at least 5000 production steps, 100000 steps, resource ceiling, or common wall deadline; preserve all checkpoints and failures. Reserve final 1800 seconds for assessment.
author_request: Create Segue 1-like cusp/core mocks with 64 stars each, evaluate acceleration, run MCMC, report ETA. Author accepted rs=150 pc after literature verification.

source_protocol.scope: Inherited numerical target, priors, samplers and diagnostic rules only; independent new mocks and campaign.

scientific_target.scope: Two single-realization DF recovery examples; no coverage or calibration claim. beta_ani=-0.5 is a common generation choice; validate DF before sampling. Untruncated analytic halo density; potential tends to zero at infinity. Negligible stellar self gravity.

spherical.parameter_mapping: Same coordinates and rectangular support as original. The nonconstant density is the joint Jeffreys volume in these named coordinates, including the systemic-velocity information block.

jeffreys.formula: log pi_J(theta)=logvolume[(partial log S_i / partial psi_j)/sqrt(2)] + 0.5 log sum_i(1/S_i); psi=first six coordinates; S_i=clip(sigma_los2_i,1e-12,1e12)+e_i^2
jeffreys.implementation: Column-scaled reduced QR with exact scale restoration, float64 automatic derivatives and JIT. No jitter, pseudodeterminant or rank cutoff in the target. Known radii and errors held fixed.

budget.reason: Operational cap for this initial run, selected before sampling; not a user-specified budget. Stop earlier after two consecutive diagnostic passes, reserve 1800 seconds for final assessment. No old campaign is resumed.

initialization.method: Each ensemble independently draws 512 candidates uniformly from the prior rectangle. Select 32 without replacement with log density tempered by 10; discard 4000 warmup. No truth or old posterior initialization.

storage: Every production transition retained in float64 HDF5 with lossless gzip level 1; warmup excluded. State and RNG checkpointed every 100 steps.
interpretation: Two fixed 64-star Segue 1-like equilibrium DF catalogues. Prior sensitivity only; no repeated-mock calibration, binary/foreground model, or observed Segue 1 inference. gamma=0 interval boundary exclusion is not core rejection. Known fixed-point precision failures remain unresolved; results are exploratory even if selected-posterior diagnostics pass.
execution_selection: Retain original float64 JIT kernels and 128-node quadrature. Auxiliary-output fusion did not improve both cases consistently; reducing all grids to 64 failed Jeffreys-density agreement. Preserve rejected benchmarks. Use GPU for Jeffreys and eight parallel CPU ensembles for uniform.
preflight_scope: CPU/GPU and batch agreement on fixed points, quadrature refinement and exact mu integration at generating points, then four end-to-end short chain/backend checks. Implementation checks, not convergence or all-support numerical certification. Repeat stronger selected-posterior checks after sampling.

preflight_disposition.reason: Retain two failed CPU/GPU precision checks in highly degenerate prior-space points (max log-density difference 0.00195; log densities 95 and 148 below the best fixed point). This is not an integrated tail-mass bound. Do not alter support, impose a rank cutoff, relax numerical tolerances or claim numerical validation. A bounded exploratory run is useful; preserve failures and require posterior checks and explicit scientific review before using results.
